def enc(x):return (json.dumps(x,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'))+'\n').encode()
def pin(x):return [len(x),hashlib.sha256(x).hexdigest()]

def ldl(a):
    n=len(a);assert all(len(row)==n for row in a)
    assert all(a[i][j]==a[j][i] for i in range(n) for j in range(n))
    lower=[[F(i==j) for j in range(n)] for i in range(n)];diagonal=[]
    for j in range(n):
        pivot=a[j][j]-sum((lower[j][k]**2*diagonal[k] for k in range(j)),F(0))
        assert pivot>0
        diagonal.append(pivot)
        for i in range(j+1,n):
            lower[i][j]=(a[i][j]-sum((lower[i][k]*lower[j][k]*diagonal[k]
                                     for k in range(j)),F(0)))/pivot
    assert all(a[i][j]==sum((lower[i][k]*diagonal[k]*lower[j][k] for k in range(n)),F(0))
               for i in range(n) for j in range(n))
    return diagonal

def certificates():
    w=[F(i,W_DENOMINATOR) for i in W_NUMERATORS];records=[];seen=set()
    for line in DATA.splitlines():
        ns=tuple(map(int,line.split()));assert len(ns)==12
        tri,lam=ns[:3],ns[3:]
        assert tuple(sorted(tri))==tri and len(set(tri))==3
        assert ROOT not in tri and set(tri)<=set(range(10)) and tri not in seen
        assert all(v>=0 for v in lam);seen.add(tri)
        tet=(ROOT,)+tri;c=[F(i in tet) for i in range(10)]
        q=[[(w[i]*c[j]+w[j]*c[i])/2 for j in range(10)] for i in range(10)]
        for i,num in zip(TAILS,lam):
            j=PARENT[i];a=F(num,LAMBDA_DENOMINATOR)
            q[i][i]+=a;q[i][j]-=a/2;q[j][i]-=a/2
        pivots=ldl(q)
        records.append({'triangle':tri,'lambda_numerators':lam,'pivots':list(map(str,pivots))})
    alltri=set(combinations([i for i in range(10) if i!=ROOT],3))
    assert len(seen)==78 and alltri-seen==set(UNCERTIFIED)
    return records

def build():
    records=certificates()
    return enc({'identity':'COMMON_VOLUME_PROJECTION_PROFILE_C_V1','root':ROOT,
                'parent':PARENT,'w_numerators':W_NUMERATORS,'w_denominator':W_DENOMINATOR,
                'lambda_denominator':LAMBDA_DENOMINATOR,'certificates':records,
                'uncertified':UNCERTIFIED,
                'scope':'One common w=sum(a_i*v_i), weak path arrows, own uniform volume centroid. Positive matrices certify these 78 tetrahedra; the other six triples are not declared impossible or feasible.'})

def main():
    assert sys.argv[1:] in (['build'],['check'])
    b=build();p=HERE/'common_profile_c.json'
    if sys.argv[1]=='check' or p.exists():assert p.read_bytes()==b
    else:p.write_bytes(b)
    print('COMMON_VOLUME_PROJECTION_PROFILE_C_EXACT_PASS',78,780,*pin(b))
if __name__=='__main__':main()
